item.subject: science
item.stem:
Tara observes human cells under a microscope. One cell is very long and thin, with thread-like branches. She knows nerve cells carry messages, cheek cells form a protective lining, and muscle cells help move food.

Which statement best explains how this long, branched shape helps the cell?

options.A: The long, branched shape helps the nerve cell carry messages over long distances.
options.B: The long, branched shape forms because carrying messages stretches the cell.
options.C: Cheek cells and nerve cells in the same person have this same long, branched shape.
options.D: The long, branched shape helps the cell move food.
